transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because, for about the last year, I've been having a lot of trouble staying focused on my work. It’s like the smallest thing just completely derails me. If my phone buzzes, or someone walks past my office door, or even if I just have a random thought pop into my head—like something about my in-laws—I'm suddenly off track before I even realize it. It's just getting really frustrating.
Did you have similar focus or attention problems when you were a child?

Yeah, looking back, I definitely had issues when I was a kid, too. I remember... well, teachers were always having to move my seat around. I just talked too much, or I'd get up out of my chair without asking. And I had a bad habit of blurting things out before they even finished asking a question. So, yeah, I guess it's been going on for a long time.
Do you often feel nervous or worried most days?

No, I wouldn't say that. I don't really feel nervous or worried on a day-to-day basis. I mean, I have normal stress from work, being a CEO and all, but I don't feel anxious most of the time. It's really just the focus and the... the restlessness that's bothering me.
